Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Another extension for pilot credits (Harmonia Labs)

Karthik / Ben — I pulled their usage and account metadata this morning. High-level findings: 

- Usage: large burst on 2026-06-18 and 2026-07-02 tied to eval runs; average token/daily now low (<3k/day) since 2026-07-15.
- Accounts: single org id but 3 distinct API keys issued across 2 engineers (both on corporate email domains). No obvious multi-account linking.
- Geo/IP: requests originate from consistent US ranges (company office IP and two cloud regions).
- Patterns: there were automated bulk-parsing jobs in June (explains initial burn). Post-July usage looks legitimate and low-volume.

I attached the extracted logs and a short CSV summary (harmonia_usage_report.csv). My recommendation: 
1) Do not auto-grant a full 30d / 50k token extension immediately given past top-ups.
2) Offer a targeted 7-day bridge with a capped token limit (10k) while they supply org verification (PO or SSO domain confirmation) and we monitor real-time usage.
3) Add requirement: no additional promo extensions within 90 days without commercial sign-off + fraud clearance.

If Ben wants to be more aggressive commercially, we can allow a larger amount but recommend requiring a PO / billing contact before the larger top-up is applied.

Neha Kapoor
Risk & Fraud Analyst
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: harmonia_usage_report.csv]

Hi Oliver — thanks for the context and for sending the pilot summary. We want to be helpful here while ensuring fair use of our promo resources. 

Quick proposal: we can provision a one-week bridge extension with a 10k token cap while we finalize verification. To move forward with the larger 30-day / 50k request we would need one of the following: a signed PO (can be pro forma), SSO domain confirmation for the pilot cohort, or a named billing contact from Harmonia.

If you can provide one of those items by Monday 9/13 we’ll prioritize the larger extension. Otherwise we’ll apply the 7-day bridge today so your team can finish the remaining validation.

Let me know which option you prefer and I’ll open the billing ticket.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
